violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED SALSA AT 46F AND CREAM CHEESE CUPS AT 58F IN THE 4-DRAWER PREP TOP. OBSERVED MILK AT 52F IN CANISTERS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED FOOD ITEMS AND WILL DISCARD MILK AT THE END OF BREAKFAST SERVICE (LESS THAN 4 HOURS). PIC UNDERSTANDS COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW AND THAT CANISTERS OF MILK SHOULD BE ON TIME OR KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW. EHS RECOMMENDS PUTTING THE CANISTERS IN A REFRIGERATOR TO HELP KEEP THE MILK COLD.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE 4-DRAWER PREP TOP AT 41F WITH DISPLAY UNIT THERMOMETER, BUT 47F WITH EHS THERMOMETER. OBSERVED DISHWASHING MACHINE MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 145.4F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC MOVED TCS FOODS IN COOLER AND UNDERSTANDS IT SHOULD NOT BE USED UNTIL IT CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F. PIC UNDERSTANDS DISHWASHING MACHINE SHOULD NOT BE USED TO SANITIZE DISHWARE UNTIL IT CAN MEET 160F AT A MINIMUM.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ONSITE AT BEGINNING OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS A CFM SHOULD BE ONSITE DURING ALL HOURS OF FOOD OPERATION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HIGH TEMPERATURE DISHWASHING MACHINE MEET A MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 159.2F AFTER 4 CYCLES.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC UNDERSTANDS DISHWASHING MACHINE SHOULD NOT BE USED UNTIL IT CAN MEET 160F. PLEASE USE THE THREE-VAT SINK TO SANITIZE DISHWARE FOR NOW AND THE ENSURE HIGH TEMPERATURE THERMOMETER IS USED TO VERIFY TEMPERATURE.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM ON SITE AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE A CFM IS ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION OF THE KITCHEN INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system AT MOP SINK FAUCET CONNECTED TO CHEMICAL SYSTEM.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PLACED ORDER FOR APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE DURING INSPECTION.
